messages:
maria: FYI FinTrust returned their security questionnaire. top asks: per-tenant RBAC change history export, redaction proof for logs, and KMS rotation evidence for tenant-encrypted blobs.
jonathan: do we already produce a per-tenant RBAC change artifact?
lee: not exactly. we stream detailed change events into the audit topic and keep structured records, but the customer-facing exports today are aggregated. per-tenant export is doable but needs sanitization to remove secrets and PII.
ravi: for SIEMs we can stream full events to customer-managed endpoints (Splunk/Elastic), but that's a different product. for audits we should produce a filtered bundle + signed manifest.
maria: FinTrust wants: 1) chronological RBAC changes (who/when/role_before/role_after/reason), 2) proof that no plaintext keys were stored, 3) KMS rotation timeline and key-id snapshots.
jonathan: i'll propose a minimal export schema: timestamp, actor, role_before, role_after, justification, request_id, export_digest. add an HMAC digest so they can verify integrity.
lee: note on KMS: we use envelope encryption. tenant data keys (DEKs) are wrapped with either customer KEKs or our KEK depending on plan. we can include rotation timestamps and KID values but never any key material.
sam: also include a brief vuln-triage note for the rotation agent. we found a timing edge that could reference a stale wrapped key during failed rotations; mitigation patched last week. include status in the bundle.
ravi: legal usually asks for an explicit attestation "no plaintext stored". sec-bot: Automated: corporate-approved attestation templates at https://internal.redwood/sec/attestations.
maria: reference the corporate attestation and adopt its language in the bundle. also they asked about redaction rules: what we redact vs retain for debugging (e.g., truncated ids).
lee: suggested redaction: full user identifiers -> redact leaving last 4 chars for correlation; hash the rest using per-export salt and include the manifest nonce. this allows intra-bundle correlation but not cross-bundle.
jonathan: risk: including a salt that is constant across bundles could enable correlation. alternative: derive a per-export HMAC key (ephemeral), store HMAC outputs for identifiers, and sign the bundle with our KMS so FinTrust can verify within the bundle only.
maria: go with the ephemeral HMAC per-export and document the verification steps. jonathan please write the spec.
sam: incident response snippet they requested: detect (policy alert on unusual RBAC change) -> triage -> freeze affected principals / rollback role changes -> capture evidence (audit snapshot) -> postmortem. include SLA windows for each step.
ravi: for evidence capture, include an S3 archive of the audit stream segment + checksums and a signed oncall statement. we can automate packaging with `sec-packager`. example: ```sec-packager --tenant fintrust --from 2024-02-01 --to 2024-02-28 --sign```.
maria: can someone commit to producing a draft artifact by EOD Wednesday? also schedule a security review call with FinTrust Tue 10am PT.
lee: i'll implement the export sanitizer and KMS-rotation slice. estimate 2 working days to deliver a sanitized proof bundle and signed manifest.
jonathan: i'll draft the export schema, the per-export HMAC approach, and update the developer/customer docs.
sam: i'll write the incident runbook snippet and the mitigation note for the rotation-agent CVE entry.
ravi: i'll enable the sec-packager job path and add the Splunk filtered-stream option for enterprise customers.
sec-bot: Reminder: file a follow-up ticket in sec-requests with tag `fintrust-audit` and assign owners: https://internal.redwood/ops/sec-requests/new
maria: owners confirmed: lee/jonathan/sam/ravi. i'll coordinate the customer call and share agenda. any blockers? :thumbsup:
jonathan: blocker 1 1 need to confirm whether FinTrust is BYO-KMS. if they BYO we only include KID and rotation timestamps; if Redwood-managed we can attach signed rotation manifests from our KMS. pinging procurement/legal.
lee: agreed. implementation differs for BYO vs managed. we'll prepare both flows and mark the bundle accordingly.
sam: note on retention: FinTrust asks for 3-year retention on evidence bundles. we have archive tier but need cost center approval. oncall: archive tier available; include cost estimate in the ticket.
maria: i'll include retention ask in the ticket and a short customer-facing checklist. thanks team.
jonathan: i'll open a PR with the schema and example bundle structure. link in ticket once ready.
lee: will add unit tests to ensure no key material is exposed and that HMACs are verified before signing.
sam: i'll attach the CVE tracker link and PR for the hotfix to the bundle.
ravi: when packaging, ensure the manifest includes: export_id, generated_by, export_window, kms_mode (BYO/Redwood), hmac_algo, signed_digest, retention_policy_note.
maria: perfect. meeting scheduled, ticket created. closing thread unless there are follow-ups. thanks everyone.
